description: Public tripleS Objekt collection index snapshot; collection numbers identify card designs, not individual serial numbers.

coverage.method: Read public Apollo HTML with member and season filters; compare first+oldest result coverage against each public total, splitting by class if necessary.

imageDependencies.delivery: Direct public COSMO images; browser fetch and canvas PNG export verified.
Public originals via https://wsrv.nl/ resize/cache, 1200px export and 300px thumbnails; browser fetch and canvas PNG export verified.

limitations: Snapshot is updated by rebuilding the catalog, not a live COSMO account integration.
Includes 24 individual members; group/unit Objekt designs are outside this member-only index.
External image providers and the public cache may become unavailable; retry or use the existing upload option.
Motion cards use their static front-image artwork.
